messages:
Alex: quick FYI — staging canary (rc4) p95 is ~120ms higher than baseline on short seqs. spotted in two consecutive runs. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.dev/canary/rc4 :eyes:
CanaryBot: automated-canary: p50:+8ms p95:+120ms error-rate:+0.2% (short_seq<=64) — triggered at 2026-03-17T16:09Z
Sam: saw the alert, thanks. which kernel/build?
Alex: v2.14-rc4, kernel=quant-amt-8, allocator=mm_alloc_v2, batch=auto
Tasha: is this across all instance types or only g5x?
Alex: reproduced on g5x and a100-staging pool
Priya: is the regression for short sequences only? long seqs stable?
Alex: correct — p95 regression concentrated on <=64 tokens
Marc: I pushed the mm_alloc_v2 patch last night (suspect).
Sam: I'll run a focused perf run with the same seed + 1k samples on perf infra. ETA ~25m.
Sam: uploaded sampling results and flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/local/2213344556/flame.svg (summary: clear spike in kernel fastpath around tok 12-18)
Priya: if repro, we should bisect commits between mm_alloc_v1..mm_alloc_v2 and kernel-quant changes. quick bisect plan:
```
git bisect start HEAD v2.14-rc3
# run perf script --sample 1000 --short-seq
# mark good/bad
```
Marc: I can drop a build with mm_alloc reverted and run the canary quick run (10 runs) if that helps
Tasha: good idea — that would tell us if allocator is culprit before full bisect
Alex: proposal: HOLD the rollout (no rollforward) until we have either a repro confirmed and bisect, or a revert test. tagging oncall for awareness @Sam
Sam: vote: HOLD :raised_hand:
Priya: vote: HOLD :heavy_check_mark:
Marc: vote: ROLLFORWARD if flamegraph is transient (but will run revert test now) :thinking_face:
Tasha: vote: HOLD (prefer revert test) :hand:
CanaryBot: canary pipeline paused for rc4 per manual hold by team. Notifying release manager.
Alex: thanks — Marc please post revert-run results here when ready. Sam will run a second independent perf pass to validate. we'll reconvene async in ~45m.
Sam: on it, running now.
Marc: revert build queued (id: build-2213344601). expected finish in ~12m.
Priya: note: if revert removes regression, we should create a small-hotfix and gate rollout behind mm_alloc fix + CI perf check for short seqs
Alex: agreed. if revert fails to fix, we bisect next. thanks everyone.
